Verified Predictions

Source: R/getVerifiedPredictions.R
getVerifiedPredictions.Rd

Get verified predictions.

getVerifiedPredictions(
  TargetSiteID,
  stressors.sstv,
  df_stressinfo,
  df_paired,
  biocomm,
  df_bioTaxaData,
  df_MasterTaxa,
  colBio,
  plotvars,
  plotdpi = 600,
  plotH = 6,
  plotW = 8,
  plotunits = "in",
  dir_plots = file.path(getwd(), "Results"),
  dir_sub = "_WoE",
  boo_plot = TRUE
)

Arguments

TargetSiteID

Site ID

stressors.sstv

vector of stressors with stressor-specific tolerance values

df_stressinfo

dataframe of stressor metadata

df_paired

dataframe of paired stressor-response samples

biocomm

default = "bmi"

df_bioTaxaData

dataframe of raw response data (counts or relative abundance)

df_MasterTaxa

dataframe of master taxa with SSTV values determined for individual taxa

colBio

default = "IBI"

plotvars

Standardized sizes, fills, shapes, and transparencies for plots. Defaults to data_plotvars

plotdpi

Standardized plot dpi. Defaults to plot_dpi. 600

plotH

Standardized plot height. Defaults to plot_H. 6

plotW

Standardized plot width. Defaults to plot_W. 8

plotunits

Standardized plot units. Defaults to plot_units. "in"

dir_plots

default = file.path(getwd(), "Results")

dir_sub

default = "VerifiedPredictions"

boo_plot

= TRUE

Value

Results text file and png files to "Results" "VerifiedPredictions" folder in working directory of box plots

Details

Required packages: dplyr, forcats, ggplot2, grid, stringr, tidyr

Examples

# None at this time
